title: Polyphemus
summary: Raleigh names Polyphemus in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Polyphemus, the sonne of Elates, left with Hercules in Mysia, who built Cios. He is not Homers Cyclops. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XIII, §. VI, sig. 268b
